title: PlateWasteEvent
description: Emitted by a plate-waste sensor (simulated camera+scale stand-in today; real vendor integration, e.g. Winnow webhook, later). Represents a single bussed-plate observation.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for this event, assigned by the producer.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this schema, e.g. '1.0.0'. Consumers must reject unknown major versions.

source_id.description: Identifier of the emitting device/adapter, e.g. 'sim-plate-cam-03' or 'winnow-adapter-01'.

source_kind.description: Distinguishes stand-in producers from future real integrations without changing the contract. 'player' (added 2026-09-20) marks a human-driven source, i.e. the version-2 game client via game-bridge.

table_id.description: Originating table, if traceable. Null if untraceable (e.g. batch bussing).

plate_item_ids.description: Menu item IDs believed present on the plate. Empty array permitted if unresolved.

confounder_flags.description: Known confounding signals captured at observation time, so downstream causal inference is not forced to infer them. Not a claim of dissatisfaction.

image_ref.description: Optional MinIO object key for a reference image. Null when no imaging stand-in is used.
